description: Validate an Ed25519-signed paxiom.receipt.v0 API delivery receipt (JSON Schema, Ed25519 signature, signer authorization via expectedIssuerPublicKeys / expectedPayTo, JCS or raw SHA-256 output binding, expiry, and settlement trust state) and return structured JSON fields. Use this instead of explain_receipt when automated code branches on valid or trustState; use explain_receipt when presenting human-readable guidance, or get_x402_verifier_info for live on-chain settlement endpoints. Deterministic, offline, and free with no auth: invalid or tampered receipts return isError=false with valid=false and the failing trustState, omitting output caps trustState at valid_signature_only, and omitting trustedVerifierPublicKeys trusts the host counter-attestation key by default.

expectedIssuerPublicKeys.description: Optional pinned base64 Ed25519 seller public keys (e.g. from /.well-known/x402-keys.json). Mismatch returns trustState="unauthorized_issuer".

expectedPayTo.description: Optional expected seller payTo address from the 402 quote. Mismatch returns trustState="unauthorized_issuer".

output.description: Optional delivered HTTP response payload (JSON value for jcs-sha256, or UTF-8 string for raw-sha256); required to reach trustState="verified".

receipt.description: Parsed paxiom.receipt.v0 JSON envelope (decoded from Payment-Receipt or X-Paxiom-Receipt HTTP header).

trustedVerifierPublicKeys.description: Optional canonical base64 32-byte Ed25519 public keys trusted to assert settlement.checkedByVerifier=true (defaults to the host key).

name: verify_receipt

checks.description: Per-stage cryptographic and structural check statuses.

issuerAuthorization.description: Seller key / payTo authorization status (pass, fail, unpinned, not_checked).

outputHash.description: JCS or raw SHA-256 payload hash check (pass, fail, not_provided, not_checked, error).

proof.description: Evidence array status summary (provided, not_provided, invalid, unavailable).

requestBinding.description: Request method and resource binding check (pass, not_checked).

schema.description: Draft-07 schema check status (pass, fail, not_checked).

settlement.description: Reported settlement state from the receipt payload.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature and keyId consistency status (pass, fail, not_checked).

receiptHash.description: Hex SHA-256 digest of the canonical signing input, or null if schema validation failed.

summary.description: One-sentence diagnostic summary of the verification outcome.

valid.description: True only when trustState is "verified" (valid signature, authorized signer if pinned, matching outputHash, non-expired, and confirmed or verify_only settlement).

title: Verify Paxiom Receipt (Structured JSON)
